text: "Come to the address below if you care about Ichihime's safety."

I found this note in Ichihime's bedroom after searching all over the Mahjong Soul Shrine. The letters on it were cut and pasted from newspaper. Wait a sec, isn't this a common kidnapping plot in dramas?
Oh no, she's in danger!
But I flipped the note back and forth 3 times and could not find the address. What a lousy kidnapper!!!//nGuess I had to find the clues myself. Let me first ask if any witness had seen Ichihime.
I walked out of Ichihime's bedroom and saw Miki Nikaidou coming. She's Ichihime's best friend. Let me ask her.
player
Miki Nikaidou
Miki Nikaidou looked surprised. It seemed she didn't really know Ichihime's whereabouts.
After Miki Nikaidou left, I started to analyze the situation. She last saw Ichihime 5 hours ago, so Ichihime could have been missing for 5 hours already.
I guess I shouldn't let too many know she was kidnapped, otherwise she could be killed. Let me check the Japanese confection shop.
Outside Park Entrance
Shop owner
I have a bad feeling after hearing the shop owner. Did she just dine and dash?
The owner's words alone are not sufficient evidence.
It must be Ichihime since she ate so much.
That, that's impressive. She managed to eat so much in less than an hour! I ran to Asaha High School immediately after leaving the shop...
I met Nana Shiraishi at the entrance of Asaha High School. She seemed to be waiting for someone.
Before I was able to greet her, Nana Shiraishi rushed to me and patted my shoulder enthusiastically.
Nana Shiraishi
I felt a crushing pain on my shoulder, so I took a few steps back to avoid her hand.
Wait, did she ask me to pay for Ichihime?
Nana Shiraishi doesn't look like lying.
Ichihime would never ask her for that.
I could still hear the owner's voice after running past a block. How terrible.
What on earth happened today? And what was that note all about?//nI felt so lost...
Osamu Saitou's company
I felt like the receptionist was expecting me. After hearing my name, she politely "invited" me to Osamu Saitou’s office and left with a smile. Another bad feeling just came to me.
Osamu Saitou
My hands were shaking as I took the bill and looked at the amount. 100,000 coppers!!!
I don't have so much money in my bank account
If I don't pay, I probably won't be able to walk out of here today
After saying that, Nana Shiraishi left in anger, riding her skateboard.
I searched around Asaha High School for hours but didn't see Ichihime anywhere. I asked a few other students, but none had seen anyone like Ichihime. She probably had never come to Asaha High School.
As the day got darker, I decided to return to the Shrine and discuss with others if I should call the police.//nWhere could Ichihime be?

Looking at Osamu Saitou's poker face and the locked door behind my back.//nI take out my credit card with reluctance, but after all, she calls me master. I will make sure I give her a good lesson after we get home.
After paying 100,000 coppers at the reception, I realize I still don't know where Ichihime is.
Receptionist
Miss Mikami…? I thought of Ichihime's friends, she probably meant Chiori Mikami. Whatever, let me go to her place first.
Chiori Mikami's home
It was a rare case that Chiori Mikami didn't go to the Mahjong club today, so I met her at her house. Speaking of it, do all the rich people like to live in big houses?
I look at the decorations in her living room. They all look like expensive antiques to me, so I pray hard that Ichihime didn't break anything again.
Chiori Mikami

I took the agreement from Riu Kujou and started to read. "Ichihime hereby purchases a piece of confidential information from Chiori Mikami at a price of 999,999 coppers. The above-mentioned cost will be paid by {var:player_nickname}."

I looked again, and saw the second page of the agreement. "If poor Jyanshi {var:player_nickname} is unable to pay 999,999 coppers, he or she can choose to carry Chiori Mikami's handbag for a month as a form of payment."
I will carry your bag hands down!
This agreement is obviously Chiori Mikami's prank.
Osamu Saitou let out a long sigh. He looked up at me helplessly.
My body? I wrapped my arms around myself and moved back to the corner.
I looked behind my back and found an expensive-looking vase going to fall. I immediately put it back.
What are you, a devil?//nSadly, I could only scream this to myself.

Osamu Saitou is definitely an evil businessman.//nAfter I was forced to sign the agreement, I started to run errands for him. When I realized, it was already dark outside. But I still had no idea where Ichihime was...
999,999 and one month of labor… Of course the latter one is easier!
After I said this, Riu Kujou seemed to give me an even fiercer look from not far away…
On the way
I carried Chiori Mikami's exquisite teddy bear handbag and followed her. However, the road started to look really familiar...

Actually, when I think about it, I don't have any real evidence to prove that Ichihime was kidnapped… That note could well be someone's prank, for example... When I look at Chiori Mikami, I feel like I've fallen into an incredible trap.
Mahjong Soul Shrine
A red thing bumped into me as soon as I stepped into Mahjong Soul Shrine. It was Ichihime.//nBefore I could ask, she pulled me into the garden of Mahjong Soul Shrine.

Today, the shrine looked different. There were decorations everywhere: stars, lights, banners... and I could also smell something delicious from not far away. Ichihime looked at me proudly. She seemed to be expecting something.
Ichihime
Ichihime's voice lowered, so did her ears and tail.//nShe seemed to really hate borrowing money from Nana Shiraishi. Thank goodness I paid for her.
Ichihime ran back to her bedroom and took out a huge gift box. She looked at me eagerly as I opened it. It's a set of one-piece pajamas with the same kind of cat ears and tail as hers.
Ichihime seemed to be really happy. I had mixed feelings looking at the expensive and embarrassing pajamas.
This gift is awesome. I feel so touched.
This gift is too expensive.
Before I could explain myself, Riu Kujou came to me and threw me over her shoulder.//nI heard Chiori Mikami's voice when the back of my head hit the floor.
I wanted to get up and tell her I'm still alive, but all I saw was darkness as I lost consciousness.

The welcoming party was nothing but an excuse... These guys just wanted to eat and drink, didn't they?!//nUnder the light, I could see everyone's smiling face. Ichihime was too tired from the day and had fallen asleep on my legs. My pants were wet from her drooling.
My wallet took a big hit, but I felt full of happiness inside. Today would be an unforgettable experience in many ways...

It suddenly rained at night, so the welcoming party had to be moved indoors.//nAfter everyone else left, Ichihime curled up next to the window, looking at the twinkling starry lights under the eaves. She looked lonely and sad...
Next, I searched everywhere in One Han City but could not find Ichihime until it got dark outside.
My phone suddenly rang, it was Nikaidou. She told me Ichihime had already returned to Mahjong Soul Shrine…
Nikaidou, when was the last time you saw Ichihime today?
Ichihime? I remember it was 5 hours ago. She said she was going to the Japanese confection shop at the park to have some yokan. Oops, is she still not back yet?
She's probably sleeping somewhere. I'll go find her.
Welcome!
Excuse me, has the Priestess of Mahjong Soul Shrine been here today?
Oh, the Priestess? Yeah, she did. She also had lots of food, without paying.
Excuse me, are you Jyanshi {var:player_nickname}?
Yes. How do you know?
Right, here's the bill. After the Priestess finished eating, she told me to hand the bill to you. It's 5,000 coppers in total.
5,000!!! How is that possible?!!
Oh well… I've been running my shop for over 20 years, but I have never seen any girl eating as much as she did. In total, she's had 12 yokan, 16 dango, 21 wagashi, 7 cups of uji matcha…
E, enough…
I think I know what happened. Here's 5,000 coppers.
That's really nice of you. Speaking of which, are you here for the Priestess?
Yes. Did she say where she was going after she finished eating here?
Not really, but my waiter said she was heading toward Asaha High School.
About what time did she leave?
Hmm… 4 hours ago, maybe.
Outside Asaha High School
Shira…
What can I do for you?
You know that little cat? She came to me today! To--tally unexpected.
What did she want from you?
She borrowed 5,000 coppers from me, said you would pay me back later, then ran away. Are you guys planning something?
5,000 coppers again!!!
Again? Did she also borrow from others?! Oh no, I thought she was finally taking me as a close friend. Guess I was just one of the many people she borrowed from…
You're missing the point! Don't make yourself sound so bitter!
Hey junior, you are not going to run away without paying me, are you?
Sorry, I can't pay for her. You should wait for the Priestess to come back.
Oh hey, don't run away! You need to pay for your bills!
Of course not. Here's 5,000 coppers. Please take it.
I know you are a trustworthy one! Anyway, I think the cat said she was going to ask some big boss for donation. I hope she's not doing anything dangerous!
Here is a detailed breakdown of your debt.
What, what debt?
You are the master of that Priestess at Mahjong Soul Shrine, aren't you?
Actually… whatever, yes, I am.
Right then. Sign here, and you can make your payment at the reception downstairs. We take cash, card or online transfer.
Um, what kind of debt is this?
The Priestess broke one of my antique vases in the office. 100,000 coppers is its market price.
It's not that I don't want to pay, but I just cannot imagine Ichihime approaching you, let alone borrowing money. Why would she go through so much hassle when she could have asked me directly?
Are you saying that I lied to you?
I'm sorry, but I must see Ichihime in person to confirm it. Your words alone are not enough.
Alright then, junior! I shouldn't have trusted you!
Are you looking for Miss Ichihime?
Yes. Do you know where she is?
When she headed out, she said she was going to find Miss Mikami.
I knew it! What did Ichihime do again this time?
Pff! I can't tell you the details, but I can let you pay for it. Aren't you thankful?
How am I supposed to pay for it when I don't even know what it's all about?
Easy, just sign on this agreement. Chiori doesn't have much time to play with you today, so hurry up, you fool {var:player_nickname}!
This number is just ridiculous. Did your keyboard get stuck or what? How could I possibly have so much money?!
How's that? Aren't you excited about the alternative? Pff! I can see your inner perverted self already. How disgusting.
Sorry, I may not be able to pay for her.
Hmm?
Insufficient balance in my bank account...
That Priestess said exactly the same thing. Are you going to find someone to pay for you?
I... cannot find anyone.
Well, you will have to pay with your body then.
What do you want?
From today onward, you will work in this company until your debt is paid off. You won't get any salary either.
Well, now that you are my servant, I shall show you some mercy and take you to Ichihime.
Do you know where she is?
Isn't this the road to Mahjong Soul Shrine?
Oh? I never know that your stinky brain can also think. How surprising! Of course this is the road to Mahjong Soul Shrine.
But Ichihime…
Strange, nyaa. Why doesn't master praise Ichihime, nyaa?
Why should I do that?
Because Ichihime did something super great today.
What's that?
Ichihime realized something this morning. Master, when you first arrived at Mahjong Soul Shrine, you didn't have any welcoming party, nyaa!
Welcoming party?
So… Is this my welcoming party?
Was leaving me a note saying you were kidnapped also a part of the planning?
What about the Japanese confection shop at the park?
...You made me speechless. What about Nana Shiraishi? Was what she said also true?
That was tough, nyaa. Ichihime didn't like her at all, but Chiori said she was the only one who would lend me the money without any condition...
Did you use the money to buy these decorations?
Is this… for me?
I will not pay one single cent before you tell me the details of your deal. Plus, 999,999 is just way too much.
Wait a...
Did you just kill him?!
Thank you, Ichihime. I really like it!
I like both the gift and you.
I'm sorry, Ichihime, but I really can't take this pajamas.
Nyaa…
I can feel your good intention, but you shouldn't have done it this way. I don't want Ichihime to be in danger because of me. I was really scared when I saw that note.
Sorry, nyaa...
That was Ichihime's favorite part of the whole party. If master stayed in Mahjong Soul Shrine, we couldn't put up the decorations. So Ichihime came out with a brilliant idea to trick you out, hehe.
Little cat? She probably meant Ichihime. But Ichihime never had much interest in her. That was unexpected indeed.
A big boss to donate for Mahjong Soul Shrine… There's only one I can think of…//nI said goodbye to Nana Shiraishi and walked toward Osamu Saitou's company.
Oh? Aren't you that perverted Jyanshi at Mahjong Soul Shrine? Are you here to pay off Ichihime's debt?
Of course, a person as lowly as you won't be able to afford it. Well, turn to page 2 then, Chiori's kind enough to give you an alternative.
Of course, there's nothing that Chiori cannot do. Hmpf!
Master, welcome back, nyaa!
Nuh-uh. The businessman sponsored them, nyaa. Here's what I bought with the money!
Nyaa~nyaa~
How dare you lowly slum dweller talk to Chiori like that? Riu, teach {var:player_nickname} some manners.
Nobody knows master better than me in Mahjong Soul Shrine. I knew you would like it, nyaa!
Yo, junior! Perfect timing. I was just about to look for you.
I know Miki is good! She managed to persuade you to pay. How could Ichihime prepare the party with an empty stomach?
One more step, and your debt will become 200,000.
Yeah, you know, the kind of party where everyone would circle the newcomer and clap to welcome, nyaa!
Yeah, just like what you think, nyaa! Ichihime's done a lot of preparation for this party, nyaa! 10 minutes, probably!
